description:
Use this when the user agrees to buy credits; it returns a link the user must complete.

Start a one-time credit purchase and return a checkoutUrl, plus a paymentLink when the deployment configures one. No charge happens until a human completes the payment; show the URL to your operator. Prefer this over retrying the metered tool after a 402.

credit_pack.description: Credit pack size; defaults to the smallest pack

name: billing_purchase
title: Start a credit purchase (human pays)
